# prerequisites, in order -- generated by examples/make_sweep.py from configs/sweeps/lafan_recovery_shac.yaml (--smoke); do not edit.
# One job per line; run with examples/run_jobs.sh <this file> (from the repo root).
# [harvest_handover_postpush] the P-pre-nominal harvest (data/g1_handover_train.pt's recipe) with the takeover 0-0.2 s after the push ENDS
python examples/harvest_g1_handover_states.py --library data/g1_lafan1_clips_train.pt --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --impulse-range 4 60 --handover-from end --samples 100000 --out data/g1_handover_postpush_train.pt  # creates: data/g1_handover_postpush_train.pt
# [harvest_walker_postpush] C-push's walker starts, pushed under the warm start (one push 0.1-0.4 s in), the takeover 0-0.2 s after it ends
python examples/harvest_g1_frontier_states.py --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --task g1_recover_lafan --dataset data/g1_recover_states.pt --weights '{"nominal": 0.1, "clean": 0.2, "pushed": 0.25, "fell": 0.3, "synthetic": 0.15, "mocap": 0, "handover": 0}' --init-level 2 --force-max 300 --min-scale 0.2 --delays 0 2 5 7 10 --kind handover --samples 42857 --out data/g1_walker_postpush_train.pt  # creates: data/g1_walker_postpush_train.pt
